classification.difficultyReason: Locate the co-interior sector, including endpoint intersections and shortened transversal drawings.

content.prompt: Draw an arc showing the angle co-interior to $t$.

spec.description: Horizontal parallels with rightward marks left of a falling transversal. t lies below the upper line between east and southeast arms.
spec.mathematics: Co-interior target is above the lower line on the same side of the transversal.

answer.short: Arc above the lower horizontal, between its east arm and the northwest transversal arm.
answer.worked: The marked angle is inside the parallels and on the same side of the transversal as $t$ (co-interior angles).

spec.description: Upper sector at lower crossing between east and northwest arms.
Vertical parallels with upward marks above the horizontal. Horizontal starts at the left vertical and extends beyond the right vertical. t is below and right of the left vertex.
spec.mathematics: Co-interior target is below the horizontal and left of the right vertical. No right-angle square is supplied.
spec.answerVisibility: Preserve the absent left horizontal extension and omit answer arc.

answer.short: Arc below the horizontal and left of the right vertical.
answer.worked: The marked angle is between the vertical parallels and below the transversal, on the same side as $t$ (co-interior angles).

spec.answerVisibility: Answer-only overlay; no added right-angle square.

spec.description: Two horizontal parallels begin on a steep falling transversal and extend right, with rightward parallel marks. The transversal begins at the upper shared endpoint and continues below the lower endpoint. t lies above the lower horizontal and right of the transversal.
spec.mathematics: Co-interior target is below the upper horizontal at the upper shared endpoint.
spec.answerVisibility: No left horizontal arms, no upward transversal continuation, no answer arc.

answer.short: Arc at the upper shared endpoint, below the horizontal and right of the transversal.
answer.worked: The marked angle is inside the parallels and on the same side of the transversal as $t$ (co-interior angles).

spec.description: Upper shared endpoint, sector between the downward-right transversal and rightward horizontal.

Falling parallels with southeast-pointing marks and a nearly vertical transversal leaning right upwards. The lower parallel and transversal end together at the lower vertex. The upper parallel extends through its crossing and the transversal extends above it. t is left of the transversal below the upper parallel.
spec.mathematics: Co-interior target is the sector at the lower shared endpoint between northwest and upward arms.
spec.answerVisibility: Preserve both lower terminations; no answer arc.

answer.short: Arc at the lower shared endpoint, between the northwest parallel arm and the upward transversal arm.
answer.worked: The marked angle is inside the parallels and on the left side of the transversal, the same side as $t$ (co-interior angles).

spec.description: Lower shared endpoint, sector between upward transversal and northwest parallel arms.
spec.answerVisibility: Answer-only overlay; no lower continuations added.
